title: The work that keeps yesterday useful
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Identify what is preserved — Name the capability people still rely on.; Check present conditions — Test assumptions against the current environment.; Repair or retire — Choose useful care rather than habitual activity.; Assign the next review — Give ownership and review a concrete reason..
